confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus or listings. Food, drink and cafe anchors are moderately well grounded; accommodation is least certain because Kyoto room rates swing widely by district, event and date, and July is peak season. Cocktail and wine were set from a typical ratio to the beer anchor (about 1.9x and 1.4x) because direct Kyoto knowledge for them is weaker. The FX figure came from RBA-domain search results rather than a direct page read, and those results showed inconsistent page date labels, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single reference city. Food and drink follow typical Japanese restaurant pricing, similar to Osaka's tourist districts. Accommodation is adjusted upward for Kyoto's July tourist-demand premium.
